confirm.title: Delete your account?
confirm.message: Everything in it is deleted. This can't be undone.

checklist.title: Before you set off
checklist.intro: Confirm each point before this journey starts. You'll go through this checklist again for every new journey.
checklist.incomplete: Confirm every point to start the journey.
checklist.complete: Every point is confirmed. You're ready to start.
checklist.note: Starting marks the journey as in progress and, with your permission, records its route in your account. No one watches it.

v1.vehicle: The vehicle is in good condition: lights, mirrors and seatbelts work.
v1.energy: There is enough fuel or battery charge for the whole journey.
v1.tiresBrakes: The tires and brakes are checked and in good condition.
v1.documents: I have my driving license and the vehicle's documents with me.
v1.fitness: I am rested and feel physically and mentally fit to travel.
v1.sober: I am not under the influence of alcohol, drugs or medicine that affects driving.
v1.phoneBattery: My phone is charged enough for the journey.
v1.contacts: My trusted contacts are added in the Safety tab.
v1.assistance: I know where to find emergency numbers in the Safety tab.

tracking.title: Journey recording
tracking.waiting: Waiting for the first GPS position.

sync.queued: Saved on this phone and sent to your account every few minutes.
sync.syncing: Saving the route to your account.
sync.pending: Saved on this phone. It goes to your account when you're back online.
sync.failed: The route couldn't be saved to your account yet. SafeRide will try again.

denied.title: Allow location to record this journey
denied.body: SafeRide uses your location only while this journey is in progress, to record its route, speed and distance in your account. A notice stays in your notifications while it records, and it stops when you complete or cancel the journey. No one watches it and no one is alerted.

deniedForever.title: Location is not allowed for SafeRide
deniedForever.body: To record this journey, open SafeRide's settings, choose Location and allow it while using the app.

approximate.title: Precise location is off
approximate.body: An approximate location can be kilometres off, so it can't record a route. In SafeRide's settings, turn on Precise location.

serviceOff.title: Your phone's location is off
serviceOff.body: Turn on location in your phone's settings to record this journey.

blocked.permissionRequired: Location access was turned off. Allow it again to keep recording.
blocked.preciseOff: Turn on Precise location to keep recording.
blocked.locationOff: Your phone's location is off. Turn it on to keep recording.

tracking.elsewhere: Another journey in progress is being recorded. SafeRide records one journey at a time.
tracking.notRecorded: No route was recorded for this journey.

notice.title: SafeRide is recording your journey
notice.text: Your location is recorded until you complete or cancel this journey.

tracking.failed: This journey isn't being recorded: SafeRide couldn't start. Try again.

incident.title: SafeRide noticed unusual movement
incident.suddenDeceleration: Your speed dropped very quickly and you've stayed stopped. This can happen for many reasons; it isn't a confirmed accident.
incident.prolongedStop: You've been stopped for {minutes} min during this journey. That can be perfectly normal.
incident.note: Nothing has been sent to anyone.

safetyCheck.title: Are you okay?
safetyCheck.body: SafeRide noticed unusual movement during your journey.
safetyCheck.explain: If you don't answer in {seconds} seconds, SafeRide only records that you didn't answer. It can't alert your trusted contacts or call anyone, so if you need help, reach out yourself.

noAnswer.title: No answer recorded
noAnswer.body: You didn't answer in time. That doesn't mean anything happened.

notice.channelBody: Asks if you're okay when SafeRide notices unusual movement during a journey.
notice.body: SafeRide noticed unusual movement. Tap "I'm safe" if you're okay.
notice.noAnswer: You didn't answer in time. No one has been alerted.
notice.off: Notifications are off, so SafeRide can only ask if you're okay while it is on screen.

escalation.waitingForConnection: Your trusted contacts have not been alerted. This phone is offline, so the request is saved here and will be sent when it reconnects.
escalation.waitingForServer: Your trusted contacts have not been alerted yet. The request reached SafeRide's server, which hasn't answered.
escalation.sending: SafeRide is trying to alert your trusted contacts.

accepted.one: The notification service accepted an alert for one contact. SafeRide can't tell whether it arrived or was read.
accepted.other: The notification service accepted alerts for {count} contacts. SafeRide can't tell whether they arrived or were read.

escalation.failed: The alert couldn't be sent to anyone.
escalation.noRecipients: Nobody was alerted: none of your trusted contacts can receive alerts yet. Invite them from Trusted Contacts.
escalation.rejected: Nobody was alerted. SafeRide's server didn't send this alert.
escalation.serviceUnavailable: Your trusted contacts could not be alerted: SafeRide's alert service isn't available. Nothing was sent to anyone. The record stays on this phone. If you need help, contact someone yourself.

guide.title: Safety Guide
guide.intro: General advice for getting around safely. It is saved in the app, so it is here even without a connection.

before.title: Before you ride
before.tip1: Check that the car, its plate and the driver match what you booked before you get in.
before.tip2: Tell someone you trust where you are going and when you expect to arrive.
before.tip3: Wait for your ride somewhere public and well lit.
before.tip4: Make sure your phone is charged.

during.title: During the ride
during.tip1: Sit in the back and wear your seat belt.
during.tip2: Follow the route on your own map app if you can.
during.tip3: Keep personal details, like your home address, to yourself.
during.tip4: If something feels wrong, ask to stop somewhere busy and get out.

after.title: When you arrive
after.tip1: Let the person you told know that you have arrived.
after.tip2: Check you have your belongings before the car leaves.
after.tip3: Report anything that worried you to the ride service.

emergency.title: In an emergency
emergency.tip1: Call the emergency number for where you are.
emergency.tip2: Give your location: a street, a landmark or a shop nearby.
emergency.tip3: Stay on the line and follow the instructions you are given.

journeys.title: Journey Safety
journeys.intro: Planning ahead gives you a clear record of where you are going and when. Telling the people you trust is up to you.

can.title: What SafeRide does today
can.plan: Lets you plan a journey: where from, where to and when.
can.review: Shows you the details to check before you save them.
can.checklist: Asks you to confirm a safety checklist before each journey starts.
can.route: Records your route, speed and distance while a journey you started is in progress, with your permission.
can.status: Keeps your journeys in your account; you start each one and mark it completed or cancelled yourself.
can.check: Asks if you're okay when it notices unusual movement, on screen or as a notification.

cannot.title: Not available yet
cannot.sharing: Sharing a journey or your location with your trusted contacts.
cannot.alerts: Alerting your trusted contacts, calling emergency services, or calling anyone for you.

emergency.title: Emergency Information
emergency.warning: Call emergency services only in a real emergency: when someone's life, health or safety is at risk, or there is a fire or a crime happening. A needless call can delay help for someone else.

choose.title: Which country are you in?
choose.body: Emergency numbers are different in each country. Choose the one you're in now; SafeRide doesn't guess it.

about.police: A crime, or danger to someone's safety.
about.ambulance: A medical emergency or a serious injury.
about.fire: A fire, smoke, or someone trapped who needs rescue.
about.roadSecurity: Help on the highways between cities.

emergency.callNote: Call opens your phone app with the number ready. You place the call yourself, and SafeRide can't see whether it goes through.
emergency.secondary: Only foreign governments' travel advice lists this number. Confirm it locally.

unavailable.title: No checked numbers yet
unavailable.body: SafeRide hasn't verified the emergency numbers for {country}. Ask locally for the emergency number where you are.

opened.title: Your phone app opened
opened.message: {number} is ready there. Press call in your phone app. SafeRide can't see whether the call was made.

invalidNumber.title: This number can't be dialled from SafeRide
invalidNumber.message: Dial {number} yourself in your phone app.

invite.linked: This contact accepted your invite. If you don't answer a safety check, SafeRide tries to alert them through the app.
invite.notLinked: To receive alerts, this contact needs SafeRide on their own phone and this invite code. SafeRide can't reach a phone number on its own.
invite.codeNote: Give this code to your contact yourself. They enter it in SafeRide, under Safety. It works once, until {date}.
invite.acceptNote: By accepting, you agree to receive alerts if this person doesn't answer a SafeRide safety check. You'll see their name and, if they added one, their phone number, but never their location.
invite.accepted: You're now a trusted contact of {name}.

errors.title: That didn't work
errors.invalidCode: That code isn't right. Check it and try again.
errors.noLongerValid: This code can't be used any more. Ask for a new one.
errors.ownInvite: This invite is for your contact, not for you.
errors.network: SafeRide couldn't connect. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unavailable: This isn't available right now. Try again later.

alerts.title: Alerts for you
alerts.channelBody: When someone who made you a trusted contact doesn't answer a safety check.
alerts.suddenDeceleration: SafeRide noticed a sudden slowdown during {name}'s journey, and got no answer to its safety check. The journey was still in progress when the alert was sent.
alerts.prolongedStop: SafeRide noticed a long stop during {name}'s journey, and got no answer to its safety check. The journey was still in progress when the alert was sent.
alerts.caution: This doesn't confirm that anything happened. SafeRide hasn't contacted emergency services and doesn't know where they are. Try reaching them yourself.

empty.title: No alerts
empty.body: When someone who made you a trusted contact doesn't answer a safety check, it shows here.

failed.title: Alerts couldn't be loaded
failed.body: Check your connection and try again.

about.title: About SafeRide
about.intro: SafeRide helps you plan safer journeys and keep your safety tools in one place. This is an early version.

stored.title: Where your information is
stored.account: Your name, email and optional phone number, in your SafeRide account. Your password is checked by Firebase Authentication; SafeRide never stores it.
stored.journeys: Your journeys and their status, in your account.
stored.route: The route of a journey you started (its points, distance and times), recorded only while it was in progress and with your permission, in your account.
stored.contacts: Your trusted contacts, in your account.
stored.preferences: Your language and appearance stay on this phone.
stored.safety: If you don't answer a safety check: what kind of event it was and when, on this phone only.

notYet.title: Not part of this version
notYet.sharing: Sharing your location or your journeys with anyone.
notYet.alerts: Alerting your trusted contacts, calling emergency services, or calling anyone on your behalf.

about.deviceNote: Your account is kept on Firebase, Google's cloud service, so it follows you to another phone. Signing out or removing the app doesn't delete it; Delete account in Profile does.

offline.title: Without internet
offline.works: Works: signing in stays active, emergency numbers, the safety guide, recording a journey in progress, and the safety check.
offline.saved: Saved on this phone and sent later: journeys, contacts and route points. They can look saved before your account has them.
offline.needs: Needs a connection: signing in, creating an account, resetting a password and deleting your account. Lists show what this phone last saw.
